title: Repository
description: What a repository says about itself.

consent.description: Each contributor besides the copyright holder and bots, with the record of their consent to the dual license.

copyright.description: The copyright holder that the generated MIT license names.

install.description: The commands that install the project, one per line.

license.description: The existing license state with no new license claim for `unlicensed`.

name.description: The project name, which titles the README.

preserved_licenses.description: Preserve reviewed existing license assets at these SHA-256 digests.

summary.description: One line without a final period, which serves as the GitHub description and the README's first sentence.

usage.description: The smallest useful example of use.

usage_language.description: The language of the usage block, such as `sh` or `rust`.

Consent.description: One contributor's consent to license their contributions under both licenses.

contributor.description: The name the Git history records for the contributor.

evidence.description: Where the contributor agreed, such as an issue comment URL.

License.description: The license state the repository already declares or the generator creates.

oneOf.description: Generate the owner's existing dual-license files.
Preserve the existing Apache-2.0-only license assets.
Preserve the existing Affero General Public License version 3 assets.
Keep the repository unlicensed and make no license claim.

PreservedLicenseAsset.description: One root-level existing license asset whose bytes must stay unchanged.

path.description: The root-level path of the existing license file.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 digest of its exact bytes.

PreservedLicenses.description: The reviewed bytes of existing license assets.

apache_sha256.description: The SHA-256 digest of `LICENSE-APACHE` for the existing dual-license format.

assets.description: Root-level existing license files with their reviewed SHA-256 digests.

mit_sha256.description: The SHA-256 digest of `LICENSE-MIT` for the existing dual-license format.
